units: <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Malachi 1:8">Targ. Mal. I, 8</cite> <he>דמ׳</he> (ed. Lag. <he>דמרע</he>) that which is sick; <cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Malachi 1:13">ib. 13</cite>.—Pl. <he>מְרִיעִין</he>, <he>מְרִיעַיָּא</he>, <he>מְרִיעֵי</he>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Exodus 18:20">Targ. Y. Ex. XVIII, 20</cite>.
<cite ref="Targum Jonathan on Ezekiel 34:4">Targ. Ez. XXXIV, 4</cite> (ed. Lag. <he>מְרָעַיָּא</he>).—
R. Hash. 16ᵃ מצלינן … אקצירי ואמ׳ we pray now for the sick and the ailing; Ned. 49ᵇ קצירי קצירי ממש מ׳ רבנן by ḳ’tsire we mean the really sick, by m’riʿé we mean the scholars (in delicate health).
